The Doings (Acts)

The Doings of the Apostles of Jesus Christ

Introduction

The Doings of the Apostles of Jesus Christ, (is a) continuation of the Good Report According to Lukas. The very important reason for this document (LIT reading), (is to) tell how the first people who believed in Jesus followed/imitated him. The Spirit of the Lord is what_helped them to tell the Good Report about him “in Hirusalim, in the entire place of Judea, and in Samarya, and in whatever village/place here on earth (LIT on top of the ground)” (1:8).

This document (LIT reading), is divided into three divisions, and this is like the three places where the Good Report about Christ was preached: (1) The doings of the Christians started in Hirusalim when Jesus ascended/was_taken_up to the sky/heaven; (2) This spread also over Judea; and (3) there also to Mediterranean as_far_as Ruma.

Also written here is the work of the Spirit of God (MS Manama) that came to the Christians in Hirusalim on the day of Pentecost. That helped and gave strength to the people and to the leaders of the believers long_ago that are told about in this document (LIT reading).

The preparing for witnessing \ior 1:1‑26\ior*

a. The final command of Jesus and his promise \ior 1:1-14\ior*

b. The replacing of Judas \ior 1:15-26\ior*

The witnessing in Hirusalim \ior 2:1–8:3\ior*

The witnessing in Judea and Samarya \ior 8:4–12:25\ior*

What Paul did \ior 13:1–28:31\ior*

a. The first going of Paul \ior 13:1–14:28\ior*

b. The meeting in Hirusalim \ior 15:1-35\ior*

c. The second/next going of Paul \ior 15:36–18:22\ior*

d. The third going of Paul \ior 18:23–21:16\ior*

e. Paul is imprisoned in Hirusalim, in Caesarea, and in Ruma \ior 21:17–28:31\ior*
